name: ICON-A AMIP-like simulation output (year 1979)
size_as_stated: 1.59m training samples for shortwave radiation and 320k training samples for longwave radiation
resolution: R2B5 triangular grid (~80 km horizontal), 47 vertical levels (sigma coordinates, up to 80 km), 5-hourly instantaneous output sampled 1 day every 2 weeks, physics/radiation timestep 6 min
access: The code will be published under https://github.com/EyringMLClimateGroup/hafner24jgrml MLradiationemulation offline. The software code for the ICON model is available from https://icon-model.org.
